description: Restores Trinity UI, platform and scoped self-development alongside the daily planner. Adds isolated preview DO bindings, truthful evolution PR states, recoverable preparation leases with compare-and-set result writes for code and plugin installation, verified orphan-branch recovery, ID attribute validation and retryable task cancellation. Failed and stale self-development proposals can be retried from the UI. Renders completed workflow replies once from original Markdown to preserve links and generated-file cards. Production dry-run build and the full local test suite pass; live deployment remains unverified.
